title: Skip shared padding in the SLi-Rec recurrent scan
head: 747087a8b6cef54a0bdc8545bc3d3bd31148f3c5
body:
### Description

The Time4LSTM driver executes every padded step, even after all histories in a batch have ended. A batch whose longest history has seven events still performs 50 cell calls at the default maximum length.

Stop recurrent work at the longest valid history and append a zero output tail. Keep one differentiable step for all-padding batches so input and parameter gradients remain zero tensors. Output shape, parameter layout and the full-width behavior for dense or empty batches are preserved.

Fixes #2460.

### Validation

[Independent validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/recommenders/actions/runs/43893999137) checks exact head `747087a8b6cef54a0bdc8545bc3d3bd31148f3c5` on Python 3.10/PyTorch 2.0.1 and Python 3.11/PyTorch 2.5.1:

- Unchanged SLi-Rec suite: **12 passed**.
- New cases on unchanged staging: **11 failed, 6 passing controls**.
- Patched model suite: **29 passed** in both environments.
- Float32/float64 tests compare outputs and input/parameter gradients with the original full-width unroll, including mixed lengths, all padding, noncontiguous views, dense histories and empty batches.
- Complete model predictions, binary cross-entropy gradients, Adam updates and file-evaluation metrics match the reference.
- Black and `git diff --check` pass.

### Measured effect

Local CPU, Python 3.12.14/PyTorch 2.5.1, one thread, five warmups and 31 alternating samples per version:

| Workload | Unchanged staging | Bounded scan | Speedup |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cell forward, 32 rows, 7 valid / 50 padded steps | 10.25 ms | 1.49 ms | 6.88x |
| Cell forward and backward, same batch | 54.93 ms | 10.01 ms | 5.49x |
| Complete file evaluation, 40 examples, maximum 7 / 50 steps | 38.76 ms | 27.87 ms | 1.39x |
| Dense 50 / 50 forward control | 10.39 ms | 10.49 ms | 0.99x |
| Dense 50 / 50 forward/backward control | 50.88 ms | 51.32 ms | 0.99x |

The complete evaluation includes the dataset, model, attention and seven ranking/classification metrics; all reported metrics are unchanged. Dense controls were about 1% slower in this measurement. Determining the bound reads the maximum sequence length once; CUDA timings were not measured. The validation workflow includes the benchmark script and results as artifacts.

### History review

Checked 1,497 upstream PR heads and 69 existing fork branches, including both reachable Time4LSTM driver versions under the current and former `rnn_cell_pytorch.py` filenames and their intermediate commits. Both execute the full padded width.

### Checklist

- [x] Contribution guidelines and code style followed.
- [x] Regressions added to the existing registered SLi-Rec test module.
- [x] Padding and differentiability choices documented.
- [x] Commit includes the required `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [x] Targets `staging`.
